name: ACU Framework
purpose: Provide a complete, mathematically‑constrained creative engine where all narrative structures are terms of a higher inductive type over the T(19,2) knot complement.
integration_level: Full topological embedding with HoTT transport and Hamiltonian symplectic flow.

constraints.symbolic_identifiers: All `label` fields and namespace segments are immutable PascalCase identifiers. Do not translate or alter them. They are the stable coordinates in the ACU topological space.
constraints.translation_rules: Within a Factor, only the `definition` and `manifestation` fields CAN BE translated. The `role` field, all `label` fields, and all structural fields (e.g., `type_binding`, `resonance`, `context.parameters`, `imports`, `sub_factor`) must remain in the original language (English). Any PascalCase token that refers to another Factor (e.g., character names, location names, concept names) MUST NOT BE TRANSLATED, even inside `definition` or `manifestation`.
